data.title: AI | JPMorgan’s James Sullivan Sees Earnings Revisions as a Marker for Buying AI Stocks
data.description: According to Bloomberg, JPMorgan Co-Head of Global Fundamental Research James Sullivan said earnings revisions might help investors identify when to buy AI stocks. Nvidia sank 14% on Friday last week, while Anthropic fell 8.5% on its second day of trading and a gauge of chipmakers sank 11%.

data.title: India Private-Sector Activity Holds Steady as Manufacturing Strengthens
data.description: According to Bloomberg, India’s private-sector activity held broadly steady in November as stronger manufacturing offset softer services activity, a flash survey by HSBC Holdings Plc showed Monday.

data.title: Krystal Suspends Automated Contracts and Services After Detecting Suspicious Transactions
data.description: Krystal said it detected suspicious transactions originating from its system. According to Foresight News, the multichain liquidity management platform has suspended its automated contracts and services as a precaution while its team investigates. Krystal said its vault was not affected and user funds remain safe, and that it will provide further updates when more information is available.

data.title: Strategy's Bitcoin Stack Is 22% Underwater, Peter Schiff Says It's About to Blow Up
data.description: Strategy's Bitcoin holdings are about 22% below their average purchase price, while Peter Schiff says the company is “about to blow up.” Bitcoin traded at $59,045 on Sunday before recovering to $61,200 on Monday, about 28% below its level a month earlier, according to BeInCrypto. Strategy's average cost is roughly $75,400 per BTC, per SaylorTracker. MSTR closed Friday at $77.80, nearly 47% below its price a month earlier. Strategy's preferred stock, STRC (Stretch), closed at $93.60 on Friday, down from near its $100 stated value in mid-November; its variable dividend is currently set at 12% a year, making its effective yield about 12.8%. Schiff cited the yield on his latest podcast when he said Strategy was “about to blow up.” Strategy countered on X on November 20, 2026, that its net reserve was negative during the 2022 bear market, when one-third of its BTC was pledged as collateral, but is now $35 billion, with all its BTC unencumbered. The company also holds about $5.1 billion in U.S. dollar assets, which its third-quarter results say covers 3.4 years of payouts. In November, Strategy sold MSTR shares to fund STRC buybacks, adding shares without adding Bitcoin. Its next weekly filing will show whether buybacks continued with STRC near $93.

data.title: Morgan Stanley’s Bruna Skarica Sees Bull Case for UK Economy
data.description: Morgan Stanley Chief UK Economist Bruna Skarica sees grounds for optimism in improving productivity, potential benefits from AI adoption and resilience among UK households and businesses, Bloomberg reported. In an episode with host Merryn Somerset Webb, they discuss UK fiscal risks, drivers of the recent productivity improvement, whether AI could raise wages and living standards, and what a stronger economy could mean for UK markets over the next five years.

data.title: Libya Oil Output Falls After Pipeline Disruption at Biggest Field
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Libya’s oil production fell after a group disrupted a pipeline carrying crude from the country’s biggest field. The incident is the latest in a series of disruptions in recent months that have curbed supply from the OPEC member.

data.title: S&P Global Ratings Says Timely Fuel Payments Are Key to PT Pertamina’s Cash Flow
data.description: According to Bloomberg, S&P Global Ratings said timely compensation from the Indonesian government is critical to improving PT Pertamina’s cash flow. The state oil company’s receivables reached $9.6 billion for the nine months through September.

data.title: India's Flash Services PMI for November Comes in at 55.3, Below 56 Forecast
data.description: According to Jin10, India's flash services PMI for November was 55.3, compared with a forecast of 56 and a previous reading of 55.8.

data.title: Singapore October CPI Inflation at 1.9%; Forecast 1.90%, Previous 2.20%
data.description: According to Jin10, Singapore's October annual CPI inflation rate was 1.9%, compared with an expected 1.90% and a previous reading of 2.20%.

data.title: Bitquery: Maple-Linked Wallets Borrowed About 70% of Syrup Loans
data.description:
About 70% of Maple’s Syrup loans—$1.75 billion—were borrowed by Maple-operated wallets at their peak on April 7, 2026, at an interest rate of about 2.7%, below the roughly 7% paid by trading firms. According to Foresight News, a Bitquery report found that the loan book totaled about $1.07 billion at the time of its investigation, comprising 47 outstanding loans across 19 wallets, with five wallets accounting for 70% of the total. The report estimated that below-market loans to Maple-linked wallets could reduce Syrup holders’ income by $4 million to $18 million over 12 months.

The report also said 97.6% of the bitcoin listed by syrupUSDC was held at Maple addresses, with a shortfall of about 400 BTC. Deposits fell 61% from $2.82 billion on March 31 to $1.1 billion. Bitquery said external lending to trading firms appeared generally normal, while related-party loans and the concentration of holder liquidity presented risks.

data.title: U.S. Probes Megaspeed and Alice Huang as Li Ming Emerges in Nvidia Chip Case
data.description: According to CNBC, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said the U.S. is investigating Alice Huang and her former company, Megaspeed International. A Wall Street Journal report identified Huang associate Li Ming, a Chinese national, as deeply involved in the Singapore-based cloud computing firm's activities and major decisions. The Commerce and Justice departments said the investigation began in 2024 over potential export-control violations, and that Huang was interviewed during an on-site check in June 2025. The Justice Department later took the lead in the criminal investigation. Li, who is out on bail in Singapore, faces five charges, including two counts of fraud by false representation. Prosecutors allege he falsely told Super Micro Computer that the company would hold and lease servers it purchased; the Singapore charges do not name Megaspeed.

data.title: Brookfield Agrees to Acquire Blackstone's PGP Glass for $1.7 Billion
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, Brookfield Asset Management Ltd., also known as Brookfield, agreed to acquire Indian specialty glass packaging maker PGP Glass Ltd. from Blackstone for $1.7 billion, according to a statement released Monday. Brookfield will fund the investment through its Brookfield Capital Partners strategy and its affiliate Brookfield Business Corp. The deal requires regulatory and government approvals and is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027.

The transaction marks Blackstone's exit, about six years after it agreed to acquire the business, then called Piramal Glass, from India's Piramal Group for about $1 billion. The sale underscores growing investor appetite for Indian specialty manufacturers with large overseas operations as global investment firms put more capital into India.

data.title: India's November Manufacturing PMI Preliminary Reading Hits 56, Above 54.5 Forecast and 54.7 Prior
data.description: According to Jin10, India's preliminary manufacturing PMI reading for November was 56, versus a forecast of 54.5 and a previous reading of 54.7.

data.title: Binance Launches TradFi-Themed WOTD Game With 14 BNB in Rewards
data.description:
According to the announcement from Binance, its Word of the Day (WOTD) game this week focuses on “TradFi Products on Binance,” with a total of 14 BNB in rewards available. The activity runs from 2026-11-23 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-29 23:59 (UTC).

Eligible users can play up to two games per day. Users who get at least five correct answers during the activity period will share a 4 BNB reward pool equally.

Users who get at least five correct answers and complete either of two trading tasks can also share a 10 BNB reward pool. The pool will be distributed according to each eligible user’s proportion of correct answers, capped at 0.01 BNB per user. The tasks are reaching cumulative trading volume of $50 equivalent in non-zero fee trades across any of Spot, Convert, TradFi, bStocks or Futures, or reaching trading volume of $30 equivalent in NEWT through Spot or Futures.

Rewards will be distributed to users’ Rewards Hub by 2026-12-13 23:59 (UTC).

New users who register using the “WOTD” referral code or referral link during the activity period will receive 10% off Spot trading fees. They may also qualify for additional welcome rewards by completing tasks in the Rewards Hub within 14 days after registration.

data.title: North Korea Showcases Its First AI Chatbot, Smart Spring
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing 38 North, North Korea has showcased an AI chatbot called Artificial Intelligence Service System 1.0, “Smart Spring,” in footage from state television. The system was developed by the Artificial Intelligence Technology Research Institute at Kim Il Sung University and Pyongyang software company Phurunhanul Trading Corporation. The institute was renamed in July 2025 from the university’s former Faculty of Information Science; Phurunhanul also sells smartphones.

The chatbot appeared at a national IT exhibition in Pyongyang from October 19 to 30 and was shown on Ryongnamsan TV on November 17. Its interface resembles ChatGPT and can answer science and technology questions in Korean or English, as well as provide translations. An on-screen notice limits questions to technology topics, bars social or political and obscene queries, and says users are responsible for consequences of malicious use.

A televised demonstration included questions about Unity 2023.3.9 compatibility, building programs with Unity, and medication for headaches. 38 North said the system classified questions, labeling one as a factual knowledge query. The institute said the underlying model is more likely an open-weight system such as Google Gemma or Alibaba Qwen than a model developed entirely in-house. Hardware, performance benchmarks, and training details were not disclosed.

data.title: Arbitrum's Third-Quarter Revenue Reaches $7.4 Million, Up 200% Quarter Over Quarter
data.description: Arbitrum Foundation investment strategy head Brendan Ma published an update on ecosystem data. According to Foresight News, Arbitrum's treasury revenue reached $7.4 million in the third quarter, up 200% quarter over quarter, while revenue so far in 2026 has exceeded $13.6 million. Robinhood Chain contributed more than $5 million in authorized revenue to the Arbitrum treasury within 100 days of launch. Arbitrum One has processed more than 2.9 billion transactions, and perpetual futures trading volume reached $72 billion over the past 30 days. The number of RWA deployments exceeded 7,000, while assets under management were approximately $1.1 billion.

data.title: ASIA MIDDAY MOVES | KOSPI Falls 3% Despite Support Measures, TAIEX Rebounds 2% as MediaTek Hits Limit Up
data.description:
According to HKET, Yonhap and UDN Money, Japanese markets were closed on Monday for the Labour Thanksgiving Day holiday and will resume trading on Nov. 24. The Nikkei 225 ended the previous session on Friday at 56,436.65, down 5.06%.

Seoul's KOSPI stood at 4,716.02 as of 04:32 UTC, down 153.94 points or 3.16%, extending Friday's slide of more than 5% despite support measures announced by South Korean authorities. The Korea Exchange activated a sell-side sidecar for the KOSPI at 11:33 a.m. local time, suspending program trading for five minutes, the second consecutive session the measure was triggered. Samsung Electronics was down 2.84% and SK Hynix down 2.96% as of 04:32 UTC. The Finance Ministry said it was preparing to deploy the stock market stabilization fund if conditions worsen and temporarily eased the daily share buyback limit for listed companies for three months.

Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index fell 143 points to 22,267 at the midday break, after opening 242 points lower at 22,168 and dropping as much as 412 points to 21,998. Turnover was HK$128.34 billion. The Hang Seng TECH Index fell 1.1% to 3,472. As of 04:32 UTC, Tencent was down 1.80% and Alibaba down 1.44%, while Lenovo was up 4.10% and NetEase up 4.22%. Leapmotor was down 14.63%.

Taiwan's TAIEX was up 777.28 points, or 2.16%, at 36,810.57 as of 04:32 UTC, after earlier falling as low as 35,442.41 and later climbing as high as 37,094.53. MediaTek and United Microelectronics (UMC) both rose by the daily limit of about 10%, and TSMC gained 2.25% to NT$2,045. Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission imposed a ban on short selling below the previous close from Monday.

In mainland China, with markets on their midday break, the Shanghai Composite Index stood at 3,499.91 as of 04:32 UTC, down 0.96%, the Shenzhen Component Index was up 0.24% at 10,280.58, and the CSI 300 was down 0.62% at 3,930.08.

data.title: Zephirin Group Cuts Bilibili Price Target by 33.33% to $14
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, independent equity research firm Zephirin Group cut its price target for Bilibili to $14 from $21, a reduction of 33.33%. The firm set its previous $21 target in September 2026.

The new target is broadly in line with Bilibili's recent Nasdaq trading range of about $13.50 to $14.00, near its 52-week low of $12.64.

Macquarie previously issued a similarly bearish report, downgrading Bilibili to Neutral and cutting its price target to $13.90 from $24.20, citing concerns about advertising budget shifts and competition from short dramas. Investing.com data showed Wall Street's consensus price target remained above $25.

data.title: EU and Indonesia Sign Trade Pact to Eliminate Tariffs on Most Goods
data.description: According to Jin10, the European Union and Indonesia signed a trade agreement that will eliminate tariffs on most goods traded between them. After more than 10 years of negotiations, the EU announced a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement with Indonesia in Brussels last Saturday. The two sides also signed an investment protection agreement to promote bilateral investment flows. Tariffs on key EU exports, including meat and dairy products, will be eliminated, while existing tariffs on cars, machinery, chemicals, and pharmaceuticals will be reduced. Indonesia’s Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs said tariffs on about 90% of Indonesian goods exported to the EU would be eliminated; the remaining tariffs would be gradually reduced over three to 15 years or receive preferential tariff-rate quotas. Over the next 15 years, EU exports to Indonesia are expected to grow by nearly 40%, while Indonesian exports of goods and services to the EU are expected to rise by more than 14%. The European Commission estimates the agreements will add 16 billion euros to EU GDP and 27 billion euros to Indonesia’s GDP. The agreements still require approval by the European Parliament and completion of Indonesia’s domestic approval process. They are expected to begin provisional application in early 2027.

data.title: Jensen Huang's Probability of Becoming Nvidia's Next CEO Rises to 19%
data.description:
The probability that Jensen Huang will become Nvidia's next CEO has risen to 19%, up from below 10% earlier today.

According to Odaily, U.S. President Donald Trump had previously called on Nvidia's board to rehire Huang.
